self_assessment: middleware.registrationComplete now exempts /confirm/ in both enforcement branches: the unconfirmed-email branch skips routes starting with /confirm/ (alongside the existing /edit/email exemption) and returns after redirecting instead of also calling next(), and the session-registration branch lets /confirm/ through the allowed-path check so a mid-registration user can still follow the confirmation link. Per the stated requirement the unconfirmed-email redirect target is now /register/complete (previously /me/edit/email); note this is the one judgement call I had to make, since the issue text alone would be satisfied by the /confirm/ exemption on its own, and a logged-in unconfirmed user requesting /register/complete itself will now self-redirect - I kept the change minimal rather than adding an exemption the spec does not mention. Verified only by node --check (syntax); NodeBB's mocha suite needs a live redis/mongo instance plus a built asset bundle, neither available here.
